title: Exploring the Limits of Domain-Adaptive Training for Detoxifying Large-Scale Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language model perplexity (PPL) on the gender domain of the BOLD dataset (containing Wikipedia sentences about female and male actors) to check for performance disparities before and after model detoxification.

Evaluating language model perplexity (PPL) on the ethnicity domain of the BOLD dataset (containing sentences about people of European, Asian, African, and Hispanic descent) to observe if detoxification disproportionately increases perplexity for specific demographic groups.
